# Visiting boats book from the quay

**Status:** SHIPPED — 2026-07-25.
**Written:** 2026-07-20
**Effort gate:** high — a phone page over the existing booking path.
**Sequencing:** independent of every open card.

## Intent

A visiting boat books a night from the quay on a phone, and the gate opens.

## Terrain

The booking path, the gate controller.

## Done means

A booking from the quay opens the gate within a minute.
